hints.title: Lazy Increment Propagation Strategy
hints.text: Rather than updating k elements eagerly, record delta increments lazily to keep increment operations constant time.

hints.title: Delta Forwarding upon Pop
hints.text: Maintain an auxiliary delta array. When popping element at index i, add delta[i] to value and forward delta[i] down to delta[i - 1].

hints.title: Custom Stack Operations Blueprint
hints.text: push appends val and delta 0 if size < maxSize. pop returns val + delta[idx] while forwarding delta down. inc(k, val) adds val to delta[min(k-1, size-1)].

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(1) push, O(1) pop, O(1) increment
complexity.notes: All operations achieve strict O(1) time complexity through lazy propagation of increments.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating up to k elements on each increment call leads to O(K) time per operation, causing high overhead under 1,000 operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Parallel increment array caches pending additions until elements are popped.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Lazy delta forwarding from top to bottom on pop for O(1) increment.

solutions.approach: Java Fixed Array Stack with Lazy Increments
